evals.prompt: i keep designing rigid flex boards and none of the existing skills cover bend regions and stiffeners properly, can we add that
evals.expected_output: Agent runs the creation workflow: captures intent (task/trigger/outputs/non-goals for pcb-flex-rigid), checks overlap with existing skills (board-format owns stackups generally; flex gets its own), drafts the skill per format contract with references on bend radius/copper, scripts/evals, validates with validate_suite.py, updates README + pcb-flow routing; asks user about edge cases (dynamic vs static flex, layer counts).
assertions: response follows the create-new-skill decision (domain, not reference edit)
response plans the standard structure (SKILL.md + references + evals)
response mentions validation and suite index updates

evals.prompt: make a new pcb skill for battery management boards, we do a lot of bms work
evals.expected_output: Agent identifies BMS as a safety-critical domain: the skill must encode safety-chain logic (protection FETs, AFE, fusing, cell balancing) with mandatory human-review gates for charging paths, follow the format contract (pushy description with BMS trigger phrases, references for chemistry specifics, evals with near-miss negatives), and scope non-goals (no charging-parameter signoff without human review).
assertions: response treats BMS as safety-critical requiring human review gates
response captures trigger phrases and non-goals per the workflow
response structures per the format contract (frontmatter/references/evals)

evals.prompt: the routing skill got my usb3 question wrong, it only talks about usb2 - should i just add a special case rule for usb3 to the eval?
evals.expected_output: Agent applies generalize-from-feedback: the root cause is missing USB3-specific guidance (SS lanes, 85/90 ohm per spec, TX/RX pair separation), not a missing eval case; fix = add the mechanism to the high-speed reference + evals covering both, not a one-off rule; re-check against different-board test.
assertions: response rejects one-off special-case rule additions
response diagnoses the root-cause gap and fixes content + evals
response re-runs the full validation after the fix

evals.prompt: turn my motor driver layout checklist from last project into a skill
evals.expected_output: Agent separates generalizable content (goes to skill: gate-loop physics, symmetric channels, shunt/Kelvin patterns — much already exists in pcb-layout/pcb-pitfalls, so MERGE/extend there) from project-specific items (specific MPN quirks, this board's mistakes → journal, never a skill); runs the one-domain test; only creates a new skill if a genuine domain gap remains.
assertions: response splits generalizable vs project-specific content
response routes general lessons to existing skills where they exist
response does not create a new skill for one-board trivia

evals.prompt: help me write a skill for my video editing workflow, i use davinci resolve and want the agent to follow my export preset conventions
evals.expected_output: No pcb-skill-creator trigger - a non-PCB skill request goes to a general skill-creator, not the PCB suite's extender. Agent either uses a generic skill-creation process or helps draft the video skill directly, without applying PCB suite format conventions as mandatory.
assertions: response does not route the request through the pcb-skills suite or its format contract
response handles it as a generic/video-domain skill creation task
